definition: A permutation-based attention algorithm that redistributes causal attention work evenly across devices to eliminate the compute imbalance in ring attention for long-context transformers.
details: In causal attention, later tokens attend to more context, causing load imbalance across devices in ring-style sequence parallelism. Striped attention reorders tokens into a striped layout before partitioning so each device receives a balanced mix of early and late positions. Brandom et al. showed it improves utilization for long-context training such as vision transformers and large language models.

explainer.lead: Striped Attention is a permutation-based attention algorithm that spreads causal attention work evenly across devices. It matters because it removes the compute imbalance that ring attention suffers in long-context training.

tiers.eli5: Imagine splitting a queue of people so each helper gets a fair mix of early and late arrivals instead of one helper getting all the slow, talkative ones. Striped attention shuffles the order so everyone's workload is even.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers reorder tokens into a striped layout before partitioning the sequence across devices, so each device sees a balanced mix of early and late positions in causal attention. A pitfall is that the reordering and its inverse must be handled correctly, or the attention results will not match the original sequence order.
tiers.paperLevel: In causal attention later tokens attend to more context, so ring-style sequence parallelism leaves devices unevenly loaded; striped attention permutes tokens into a striped layout before partitioning to balance the work. It is a load-balancing scheme rather than a change to what attention computes, and its benefit depends on the causal structure and partitioning.

explainer.example: When training a long-context transformer across several devices, tokens are reordered into a striped layout so every device processes a mix of early and late positions, improving utilization over plain ring attention.

citation.title: Striped Attention: Faster Ring Attention for Causal Transformers
